questions.prompt: How much wind power capacity was installed worldwide at the end of 2025, in gigawatts, according to IRENA?
questions.insight: Wind added 159 GW in 2025, growing 14.0% in a single year.

questions.prompt: Worldwide, general government gross debt was what percentage of world GDP in 2024, according to the IMF's Global Debt Database (weighted average across countries)?
questions.insight: Global public debt was 84% of world GDP in 2019, before rising to 93% in 2024.

questions.prompt: According to Amnesty International, how many countries had abolished the death penalty for all crimes at the end of 2025?
questions.insight: Counting countries that have abolished it in law or in practice, Amnesty reports 145 in total.

questions.prompt: What was the global unemployment rate in 2025, according to the ILO's Employment and Social Trends 2026 report? (Share of the world's labour force aged 15+ that is without work but actively seeking it.)
questions.insight: Headline unemployment is low and stable, but youth unemployment is far higher, at 12.4% in 2025.

questions.prompt: According to the UN's State of Food Security and Nutrition report (FAO estimates), what share of the world's population was undernourished (chronically lacking enough food energy) in 2025?

source.name: FAO, IFAD, UNICEF, WFP and WHO (SOFI 2026)

questions.insight: That is about 645 million people, nearly 14 million fewer than in 2024.
